config.jade.display_blocks.tooltip: Describe the block under the crosshair.
config.jade.display_bosses.tooltip: Describe the Ender Dragon and the Wither.
config.jade.display_mode.tooltip: Toggle: the Show Overlay key turns it on and off. Hold: shown while the key is held. Lite: only the main lines, the rest with Show Details held.
config.jade.fluid_mode.tooltip: Any: fluids are targets. None: never. Fallback: only when no block is hit.
config.jade.boss_bar_overlap.tooltip: What to do when a boss bar is where the tooltip goes. No effect yet: the mod API cannot read boss bars (API-GAPS.md).
config.jade.extended_reach.tooltip: Blocks beyond your reach that the overlay still describes.
config.jade.hide_from_guis.tooltip: Hide the overlay while a screen is open.
config.jade.hide_from_player_list.toolti: Hide the overlay while the player list is shown.
config.jade.pos_x.tooltip: Where the tooltip sits across the screen, 0 left to 1 right.
config.jade.pos_y.tooltip: Where the tooltip sits up the screen, 0 bottom to 1 top.
config.jade.anchor_x.tooltip: Which point of the box sits at the position, across.
config.jade.anchor_y.tooltip: Which point of the box sits at the position, down.
config.jade.auto_scale_threshold.tooltip: A tooltip taller than this share of the screen is shrunk.
config.jade.animation.tooltip: Fade the overlay and morph the box when the target changes.
config.jade.disappearing_delay.tooltip: Seconds the tooltip stays after you look away.
config.jade.flip_main_hand.tooltip: Mirror the position when your main hand is the left one.
config.jade.mod_name.tooltip: The last line: the mod the target comes from.
config.jade.harvest_tool.tooltip: The tools that mine the block, and whether yours harvests it.
config.jade.harvest_tool_creative.toolti: Show the harvest tool in creative and spectator mode too.
config.jade.effective_tool.tooltip: Show the check or cross for blocks any tool can harvest too.
config.jade.harvest_tool_new_line.toolti: Put the tool icons on a line of their own.
config.jade.show_unbreakable.tooltip: Say when a block can't be broken.
config.jade.breaking_progress.tooltip: A bar along the box's bottom edge while you mine.
config.jade.block_states.tooltip: The block's states, with Show Details held.
config.jade.block_properties.tooltip: Explosion resistance and destroy time, with Show Details held.
config.jade.redstone.tooltip: Levers, repeaters, comparators and powered blocks.
config.jade.furnace.tooltip: A furnace's, smoker's or blast furnace's items and progress.
config.jade.brewing_stand.tooltip: Blaze powder left and the brewing time.
config.jade.beehive.tooltip: Honey and bees in a hive or nest.
config.jade.spawner.tooltip: The mob a spawner makes, in its name.
config.jade.campfire.tooltip: What cooks on it and how long is left.
config.jade.tnt_stability.tooltip: TNT that goes off when punched.
config.jade.hopper_lock.tooltip: Say when a hopper's inventory is locked.
config.jade.block_face.tooltip: The face you look at, after the name.
config.jade.distance.tooltip: How far the block is, after the name.
config.jade.item_storage.tooltip: What is inside chests, barrels, hoppers and other containers.
config.jade.items_per_line.tooltip: Icons in each row of a container's contents.
config.jade.normal_amount.tooltip: Kinds of items shown without Show Details.
config.jade.detailed_amount.tooltip: Kinds of items shown with Show Details held.
config.jade.show_name_threshold.tooltip: With this many kinds or fewer, each gets a row with its name.
config.jade.entity_health.tooltip: Hearts, or a number for very healthy mobs.
config.jade.max_health_for_render.toolti: Above this much health, show a number instead of hearts.
config.jade.show_fractions.tooltip: Health as a decimal number, not rounded up.
config.jade.villager_profession.tooltip: A villager's job (and level, with Show Details held).
config.jade.mob_growth.tooltip: Time until a baby grows up.
config.jade.mob_breeding.tooltip: In love, or time until it can breed again.
config.jade.horse_stats.tooltip: Jump height, speed and a llama's strength.
config.jade.item_entity.tooltip: A dropped item's name and count.
config.jade.armor_stand.tooltip: What an armor stand wears and holds.
config.jade.zombie_villager.tooltip: Time until a cured zombie villager converts.
config.jade.next_drop.tooltip: Time to a chicken's next egg or an armadillo's next scute.
jade.config.title: Jade: Click to change, right-click to go back, Shift steps faster
